bundle.shortDescription: Cockpit for orchestrating fleets of AI coding agents
bundle.longDescription: Agent Studio is a native desktop IDE for orchestrating fleets of AI coding agents. It embeds real terminals, runs the Claude Code CLI inside them, and visualizes the tree of sub-agents each agent spawns, alongside editors, a workspace file tree and a database client.
